oil.when: 2002 (CHANGE OIL light reset with the button in the instrument panel fuse block)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press the RESET button in the instrument panel fuse block on the driver's side (you may need to remove the fuse block cover).
When the CHANGE OIL light starts to flash, press and hold the RESET button again.
The reset is done when the chimes sound and the CHANGE OIL light goes out.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON with the engine off.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
The reset is done when you hear the chimes and the CHANGE OIL light goes out. If the light stays on with no chime, repeat the steps.
Turn the key off. If CHANGE OIL comes back on when you start the car, repeat the steps.
